description: Figure 3 illustrates the inter-annotator agreement in relation to sample-level ambiguity standard deviation and maximum ambiguity values, using two bar charts. The categories are represented on the horizontal axis, while the vertical axis is labeled "Fleiss Kappa" with a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 0.8 in intervals of 0.2. In the left chart, the bars are labeled with their corresponding ambiguity standard deviation values (0.0, 0.47, 0.82, and 0.94) and are colored in dark blue, with heights corresponding to Fleiss Kappa values of approximately 0.88, 0.46, 0.03, and 0.24, respectively. In the right chart, the bars are labeled with their maximum ambiguity values (1, 2, and 3) and are also colored in dark blue, with heights corresponding to Fleiss Kappa values of approximately 0.89, 0.46, and 0.23, respectively. The bars in both charts are not grouped or stacked and are sorted in ascending order of their respective ambiguity measures. No bars are visually emphasized.
